mentions.name: Bedtime Book Helper
mentions.description: A story time utility for building a personal book library: users scan in their physical books or discover OpenLibrary books to read in the app. As books are marked read, it builds a reading rotation and recommends books that haven't been read recently, supporting goals like tracking 1000 books before kindergarten. Google Play release and multiple story time attendee support are in progress.
mentions.audience: Parents doing bedtime story time with young children
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on a story time utility.(https://bedtimebookhelper.com/)

You build up a library from your physical books by scanning them in or discover OpenLibrary books to read in app. Then as you mark books in your library as read, it starts building a rotation and recommending books you haven’t read recently.
